Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
So if you have the "old" Marcus, who is already Camarilla, but he equips
with a Writ of Acceptance anyway, and then you merge him with Advanced
Marcus (becoming Lasombra), can he remain Prince?

How about if you merge him and *then* give him the Writ (before someone
else took the title away)? Would he get his Princeship back?

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
> So if you have the "old" Marcus, who is already Camarilla, but he equips
> with a Writ of Acceptance anyway, and then you merge him with Advanced
> Marcus (becoming Lasombra), can he remain Prince?

Yes.

> How about if you merge him and *then* give him the Writ (before someone
> else took the title away)? Would he get his Princeship back?

Yes.

Also, if you brought out Marcus Advanced and equipped him with a
Writ and then merged his base version under him, he'd become a prince.
